requestBody.query: Using voice commands with your Fibe TV Box or Streamer

200.answer: To search across installed apps, press the Google Assistant button on your remote or select the Google Assistant icon. To control power and volume, you can say "Sleep," "Volume down," or "Volume up 10%".
